gloss: mekabu; the frilly root part of wakame seaweed

definitions.explanation: The thick, ruffled part at the base of a wakame frond, sold chopped and eaten for its slippery texture. Usually written in hiragana or katakana.

examples.japanese: めかぶ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
めかぶ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧そうだ。
examples.english: They say mekabu is good for you.

examples.japanese: {朝|あさ}ごはん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、めかぶ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{納豆|なっとう}→納豆：04930_nattou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{混|ま}ぜて→混ぜる：02423_mazeru⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧になっている。
examples.english: Mixing mekabu with natto for breakfast has become a habit of mine.

notes:
The base of a wakame plant, just above the holdfast. When chopped it becomes very slippery, and that texture is the point of the dish.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {刻|きざ}みめかぶ: chopped mekabu (the usual supermarket form)
- めかぶ⟦{納豆|なっとう}→納豆：04930_nattou⟧: mekabu mixed with natto
- めかぶ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{酢|す}の{物|もの}→酢の物：04982_sunomono⟧: mekabu in vinegar dressing
- ⟦ねばねば→ねばねば：05258_nebaneba⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be sticky and slippery

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦わかめ→わかめ：10654_wakame⟧: wakame — the leafy blade of the same plant, sold separately
- ⟦もずく→もずく：28690_mozuku⟧: mozuku — a different slippery seaweed, usually served in vinegar
